title: Pure D/D
summary: Pure D/D Pendulum and multi-summon combo strategy featuring Declan Akaba's fiendish corporate hierarchy and Dark Contract Spells, bolstered by the 2025 support wave. By utilizing D/D/D Abyss King Gilgamesh to set Pendulum Scales directly from the Deck and recycling materials with D/D/D Alfred the Divine Sage King, the deck fields multi-layered negations and absorbs opponent monsters with D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex.

summary.title: Starters
points: D/D Savant Kepler on Normal or Special Summon searches any Dark Contract card from Deck to hand (most notably Dark Contract with the Gate).
Dark Contract with the Gate searches any D/D monster from Deck to hand once per turn, paying 1000 LP during each Standby Phase.
D/D Savant Copernicus on summon sends any D/D or Dark Contract card from Deck to GY, loading D/D Necro Slime or Dark Contracts.
D/D Swirl Slime Fusion Summons a D/D/D Fusion Monster from hand using itself and another D/D monster, and banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon a D/D from hand.
Dark Contract with the Zero King destroys another D/D card you control to Special Summon any D/D monster directly from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: D/D Swirl Slime + D/D Savant Kepler
steps: Normal Summon D/D Savant Kepler and activate its effect to search Dark Contract with the Gate from your Deck.
Activate Dark Contract with the Gate to search D/D Necro Slime (or D/D Gryphon) from your Deck.
Activate D/D Swirl Slime in hand, fusing itself and Necro Slime into D/D/D Flame King Genghis.
Banish D/D Swirl Slime from your GY to Special Summon a D/D monster from hand; trigger Flame King Genghis to revive D/D Necro Slime from your GY.

Link Summon D/D/D Abyss King Gilgamesh using Genghis and Kepler, activating its effect to take 1000 damage and place two D/D Pendulum monsters (such as D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex and D/D Gryphon) into your Pendulum Zones.
Pendulum Summon your Extra Deck and hand D/D monsters, then Synchro Summon D/D/D Gust King Alexander with D/D Lance Soldier or overlay into D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex can overlay directly on top of any D/D/D monster; up to thrice per turn, when an opponent's monster activates its effect, it detaches 2 materials (or destroys a Dark Contract) to attach that monster to itself as material.
D/D/D Gust King Alexander revives a Level 4 or lower D/D from the GY each time another D/D is Normal or Special Summoned while it is on the field.
D/D/D Cursed King Siegfried targets and negates 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field as a Quick Effect on either player's turn.
D/D/D Alfred the Divine Sage King Fusion Summons a D/D/D by shuffling materials from hand, field, or banishment into the Deck, and returns Dark Contracts to the field when banished.
D/D/D/D Dimensional King Arc Crisis is a supreme Fusion that negates all face-up monsters the opponent controls and attacks each of them in sequence.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex places a Dark Contract from Deck upon activation and revives itself from the face-up Extra Deck to destroy a card whenever a D/D/D or Dark Contract is destroyed.
Dark Contract with the Different Dimension shuffles two Dark Contracts into the Deck to banish a card from the opponent's field or GY.
D/D/D Headhunt takes control of an opponent's face-up monster until the End Phase of the next turn while you control a D/D/D monster.
Dark Contract cards inflict 1000 LP damage to you during each Standby Phase, creating high risk that the deck mitigates through fast victories or LP manipulation.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Fiendsmith engines and Spright Elf are omitted to maintain an authentic pure D/D/D Extra Deck; Spright Elf is also Forbidden in the TCG.

main: D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex
Scale 0: the turn it's activated, places a Dark Contract from the Deck. Face-up in the Extra Deck, it comes back when a D/D/D or Dark Contract card is destroyed, then destroys a card.
D/D Savant Kepler
Scale 10. Summoned: searches a Dark Contract card or returns another D/D to the hand.
D/D Savant Copernicus
Scale 1. Summoned: sends a D/D or Dark Contract card from the Deck to the GY.
D/D Necro Slime
From the GY, Fusion Summons a D/D/D by banishing its materials from the GY.
D/D Swirl Slime
Fusion Summons a D/D/D from the hand; from the GY, summons a D/D from the hand.
D/D Count Surveyor
Discards another D/D to Special Summon itself; Scale 1.
D/D Defense Soldier
Summons a D/D from the Pendulum Zone; from the GY, adds a D/D Pendulum from the Extra Deck or GY.
D/D Lance Soldier
Tuner that raises a D/D's Level per Dark Contract; revives itself by destroying a Dark Contract.
D/D Scale Surveyor
Special Summons itself next to a D/D Pendulum and becomes Level 4; Scale 9.
D/D Extra Surveyor
Discards to add a face-up D/D Pendulum from the Extra Deck to the hand.
D/D Gryphon
Special Summons itself next to a D/D; Scale 1.
D/D Savant Thomas
Scale 6: adds a face-up D/D Pendulum from the Extra Deck; summons a Level 8 D/D/D from the Deck.
D/D/D Vice King Requiem
Scale 8: destroys Dark Contracts to summon itself from the Pendulum Zone at an adjusted Level.
Dark Contract with the Gate
Searches a D/D monster each turn, for 1000 LP each Standby Phase.
Dark Contract with the Zero King
2025 support. Destroys another D/D card to summon a D/D from the Deck.
Dark Contract with the Different Dimension
2025 support. Shuffles two Dark Contracts back to banish a card from the opponent's field or GY.
D/D/D Headhunt
With a D/D/D out, takes control of an opposing monster until your next turn's End Phase.
extra: D/D/D Alfred the Divine Sage King
Newest support. Fusion of two D/D: Fusion Summons a D/D/D by shuffling materials from the hand, field or banishment into the Deck; banished, puts Dark Contracts back on the field.
D/D/D Abyss King Gilgamesh
Link-2 for two D/D: places two D/D Pendulums from the Deck in the Scales.
D/D/D Wise King Solomon
Rank 4 for two D/D: detaches to search any D/D card.
D/D/D Sky King Zeus Ragnarok
Link-3: destroys a D/D or Dark Contract for an extra Pendulum Summon, and negates a hand trap.
D/D/D Flame King Genghis
Fusion of two D/D: revives a D/D whenever another D/D is summoned.
D/D/D First King Clovis
Level 6 Synchro: revives a banished D/D, or one from the GY if a Dark Contract is out.
D/D/D Cursed King Siegfried
Level 8 Synchro: negates a face-up Spell or Trap on either turn.
D/D/D Wave King Caesar
Rank 4 for two Fiends: revives the monsters destroyed this turn; sent to the GY, searches a Dark Contract.
D/D/D Gust King Alexander
Level 7 Synchro from a D/D Tuner: revives a Level 4 or lower D/D from the GY whenever another D/D is summoned.
D/D/D Super Doom King Dark Armageddon
Rank 8 for two D/D/D: protects your Pendulums and destroys a monster per Pendulum you control.
D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex
Rank 10, also on top of a D/D/D: attaches an opposing monster that activates its effect.
D/D/D/D Dimensional King Arc Crisis
Fusion of four Fiends (Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum): negates every opposing monster and attacks each one.
